description: Carnacina, Iacopo at Liverpool John Moores University publishes hydraulic-performance observations for an alternative manhole design through Co-UDlabs. Liverpool John Moores University and IKT assess a manhole intended to accommodate separate sewers in narrow streets and dissipate flow energy. The deposit represents full-scale IKT tests; earlier structural and scale-model assessments described in the source are background. Coverage is the IKT demonstration facility in Germany; individual test geometries and dates are unspecified. Zenodo provides one experiment-data ZIP archive with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the archive contents were not examined, and performance claims should not be generalised to untested street slopes or network conditions. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
